0022600168.text: The Utah Jazz (1-5, on a four-game losing streak and 14th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (4-2, winners of four straight and 4th in the West) for the Jazz's 7th game of the 2026-27 season. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Jazz trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 117-111 in Salt Lake City on October 28, and they lost 1-2 to the Spurs in the 2025-26 season.
